variant_description: non-stationary learning rate — learners speed up or slow down mid-session

protocol.cohort: identical across arms for a given (variant, seed); comparisons paired
protocol.censoring: a learner who does not master by the budget contributes the budget and mastered=false; the co-primary knowledge gain is uncensored
protocol.inclusion: learners with the whole curriculum already mastered at their first item are screened out (preregistration §9.2)
protocol.time: on-task seconds only — between-session gaps are not learner time
